ios.desc:
Motormait keeps everything your car needs in one place. Track the service history of every vehicle, log fuel and EV charging, stay ahead of safety recalls, and never miss an insurance or registration renewal again.

What you can do:
  - Add a car in seconds: scan or type the VIN in the US and Canada, or type the registration number in the UK and the Netherlands
  - Log every service — oil changes, tire rotations, brakes, and more
  - Track EV charging sessions with kWh, cost, and efficiency trends
  - See safety recalls from NHTSA in the US, DVSA in the UK and RDW in the Netherlands
  - Track insurance, registration, MOT, NCT, APK and PUC renewals with automatic reminders
  - See monthly expense charts and efficiency trends at a glance
  - Attach receipts and documents to any service or renewal record
  - Set service reminders with notifications before anything comes due
  - Export your full service history as a PDF report or CSV spreadsheet

Made for where you drive. Motormait works in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands and India. Distances, fuel, money, dates and renewal types are set for your country.

Built for every driver. Whether you drive one car or manage a whole household, Motormait keeps your vehicle history organized and your reminders on time so nothing falls through the cracks.

quotes.text:
One of my 2023 resolutions was to learn how to build an iOS app. I am happy to announce that finally a very not so fancy app that I built is now available on iOS App Store. And when I say - I built it - it is truly by me. Everything - design (however ugly or beautiful) and code is implemented by me - not outsourced to anyone!

It lets you keep track of your vehicles and associated details like services.  It will require you to create an account to access all functionality.

The name of the app is: Motor Vehicle Log

It’s an MVP and it’s currently free! It is only available in US and on iPhone with iOS 17+

If you have time, please download and install this app and give me any feedback you may have! Send your feedback to support@motorvehiclelog.com

https://www.motorvehiclelog.com/

Here is a direct link to the app at AppStore

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/motor-vehicle-log/id6475635799

Not sure if I will ever release a new version of this app but the feedback I will receive may motivate me to continue working on it through 2024 too!
